title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 18 | The Moonlit Graveyard | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
A spooky (but cute!) walk through the moonlit graveyard. The giggling ghosts belong to Nyx the Necromancer, a shy black cat who just wanted friends. Together they calm the Phantom Lantern and end the night with a lantern picnic.

0:00 A Spooky Walk
0:45 Nyx the Necromancer
1:30 The Phantom Lantern
2:15 Lantern Picnic

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
